description: REAL ACTION: reports back to the advertising platform what became of a lead, so campaign optimisation learns from business outcomes instead of form submissions. Events: lead (value = lead score), qualified, meeting, offer, won (value = the deal amount). Refuses without marketing consent, and refuses a second report of the same event for the same lead. Personal data is normalised and SHA-256 hashed before it leaves; the click id goes unhashed because it identifies the click, not the person. Providers with a verified delivery contract send directly (ChatGPT Ads via its Conversions API; for ChatGPT Ads lead, confirmed meeting and won are also reported automatically every 5 minutes). Use dry_run to inspect the draft. LinkedIn additionally needs the conversion to exist in Campaign Manager: its URN goes into the credentials as conversion_lead / conversion_qualified / conversion_meeting / conversion_offer / conversion_won, and LinkedIn can only match on a hashed e-mail.

currency.description: ISO code, default the lead's currency, then EUR.

dry_run.description: Build and show the payload without sending and without recording.

event.description: Outcome of the lead to report to the ad platform

occurred_at.description: When it happened (ISO). Default now. Platforms accept up to 7 days back.

value.description: Deal amount for 'won'/'offer'. Omitted: nothing is invented.

name: report_ad_conversion
